title: PriceMinister创始人欲从乐天回购法国平台
original_title: PriceMinister founder wants to buy back platform from Rakuten
summary: The founder of French online marketplace PriceMinister, Pierre Kosciusko-Morizet, has announced that he is preparing a takeover bid for Rakuten France. This Japanese company acquired the French platform in 2010. This will mean a return to his former company, sixteen years after selling it. PriceMinister was a French online marketplace,…
